Subject: Discovery recap + request: 30m VP/CTO handshake + technical deep dive

Hi Sam & Jorge —

Thanks again for the run-through today. Quick recap + proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- What we heard: RetailCo wants to reduce latency on search-driven personalization, cut per-query inference costs, and maintain strict data isolation for PII-sensitive logs.
- Suggested next step: a 30-minute VP/CTO handshake (to align executive goals + procurement signals) followed by a separate 60-minute technical deep dive (infra, quantization options, runbook).
- Proposed windows (PT): Tue 8/24 11:00–11:30, Wed 8/25 14:00–14:30, Thu 8/26 09:30–10:00. For the technical deep dive we propose Mon 8/30 10:00–11:00 or Tue 8/31 15:00–16:00.

I've attached the short discovery notes and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones and required procurement items. If one of the handshake windows works, we’ll send a calendar hold and follow with a tailored deep-dive agenda.

A couple of asks for you:
1) Which VP/CTO should we invite for the handshake (name & CTO email)?
2) Any constraints from procurement (SOW timeline, PO cadence, security review owners)?

Thanks — I’ll keep these slots tentative until I hear back.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0148

Jorge (CC’d) is our SVP of Engineering and should be on the handshake. His CTO, Priya Nair (priya.nair@retailco.com), will be the technical exec to join if available.

We’re generally available for the 8/24 11:00 PT slot. Quick note on procurement — we need an outline of expected contract length and data handling posture for PII before legal will engage; happy to accept a short one-pager.

Perfect — 8/24 11:00 PT works for us.

Plan: we’ll book a 30-minute VP/CTO handshake on Mon 8/24 11:00–11:30 PT. After the handshake, we’ll propose 60-min technical deep-dive windows (I listed two options in the MAP).

Per your procurement ask — attaching a one-page summary of contract options and our data handling summary (PII posture, SOC 2 scope, ingestion controls). If you want more detail before the handshake I can loop in our compliance lead.

I’ll send the calendar invite to everyone including Priya and Jorge and include the MAP + one-pager as attachments. If Priya prefers a slightly longer handshake (40m) let us know and we can extend.

Thanks,
Tessa
